title: Vesper and the Colony
author: Kestrel Blackwood
blurb: Noor Blackwood, a clone who inherited the original's murder case, has spent three years hauling cargo through contested orbits. But when gravity flickers across the entire system for exactly nine seconds, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must decide which half of humanity wakes from cryosleep before Earth's last transmission loop ends.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
